parsed.why: No trans-specific offence and anti-discrimination articles, but police use morals laws to detain trans women, custody is by birth sex with documented rape and official non-investigation, and impunity for anti-trans violence plus 2022 activist killings.

Criminalisation upheld by the constitutional court in 2024 and enforced against gender-nonconforming people: a trans woman sentenced to eight years in a men's prison, documented arbitrary arrests, police assault, service denial and top-level official hostility.

No criminalisation and strong court rulings, but documented public and institutional discrimination plus frequent physical and sexual harassment of visibly trans people, rising anti-LGBTQ political mobilisation, and thin practical remedy.

Decriminalised in 2021 and society shows invisibility rather than persecution, but police dismiss trans complaints because ID reads male, producing documented impunity, elevated assault risk and care refusal, with no anti-discrimination redress.

Comprehensive hate-speech, discrimination and hate-crime law plus liberal society, but rising reported hate crimes, falling clearance, a 2022 Pride mass shooting and extremist hostility keep it below full acceptance.
